ns2:section.sectionText: Ideas that are sometimes portrayed as the unique inheritance of Western Europeøfor example, Christianity, human rights, industrial capitalism, and scienceøactually emerged through centuries of interaction with other cultures. In this small class, we will begin with a basic understanding of the events and then move on to interpretation and debate about the østoryø behind history. Students can expect to write and discuss on a regular basis. First year Discovery Program course. Registration restricted to freshman. Students should only enroll in one Discovery course.
